title: OMP-Native Usage -> KAD Telemetry Bridge
non_scope: re-interpreting provider quotas independently from OMP authority
active polling loops or background provider scraping
acceptance_criteria: Wayfinder architectural decision selects the narrowest stable public OMP usage boundary.
One authority chain: OMP provider adapters interpret quota -> KAD normalizes into kad-telemetry-v1.
Native Codex and Antigravity usage reports map to truthful telemetry records without invented units.
Multi-window quotas (primary, secondary, model/tier scopes) remain distinct and un-collapsed.
Explicit provider allowed=true/limitReached=false outranks misleading advisory 100% percentages.
Passive after_provider_response hook captures response evidence without secret persistence or active polling.
Zero active background polling loops or credential scrapers.
Compact meter replaces 'QUOTA ?' with truthful provider-aware status when known.
All previous research regression tests (47/47) and control-plane tests remain green.
description: Thin bridge consuming native OMP 18.0.10 provider usage/quota reports and passive after_provider_response telemetry into KAD normalized telemetry plane.
